ITA-4.6.12 bhedaḥ भेदः
Stage of disease developing into subtypes or leading to complications
The sixth stage of disease manifestation kālaḥ, when the established disease or condition differentiates into subtypes based on dosha and which may signal complications.

.13 bhedanam भेदनम्
Strong laxative
A type of therapeutic action which breaks down faecal matter or vitiated dosha and expels them.

ITA-9.6.65 bhedanakarma भेदनकर्म
Incision and drainage
The procedure of incising a fluid-filled cavity for drainage.

ITA-9.6.133 bhedanakarma भेदनकर्म
Incision
Incision procedure for wound management.

ITA-9.6.206 bhedanakarma भेदनकर्म
Removal of foreign body by incision
The removal of a loosely impacted foreign body by incision.

ITA-9.5.10 bhedyarogaḥ भेद्यरोगः
Eye disorders for incision
Eye diseases in which the surgical procedure of incision is indicated.
